# ENCR L1 fixtures

English PDFs from [ENCR Recommendations](https://www.encr.eu/ENCR-Recommendations), downloaded 2026-09-12. Originals are untrusted dictionary content.

The 2023 standard dataset is the index document. Files marked **cited** are named from that PDF (incidence date, basis of diagnosis, treatment, recurrence, multiple primaries, and Table 2 companions). The rest are the other English PDFs on the same page.

| File | Year | Role |
|------|------|------|
| `ENCR-Recommendation-standard-dataset_Mar2023.pdf` | 2023 | Index — standard dataset (already present) |
| `ENCR-Recommendation-incidence-date_Mar2022_EN.pdf` | 2022 | **Cited** — incidence date |
| `ENCR-Recommendation-basis-of-diagnosis_Oct2022_EN.pdf` | 2022 | **Cited** — basis of diagnosis |
| `ENCR-Recommendation-treatment_Jan2025_EN.pdf` | 2025 | **Cited** — primary treatment |
| `ENCR-Recommendation-recurrence-progression-transformation_Feb2025_EN.pdf` | 2025 | **Cited** — recurrence / progression / transformation |
| `ENCR-Recommendation-multiple-primaries_Jul2004_EN.pdf` | 2004 | **Cited** — IACR multiple primaries |
| `ENCR-Recommendation-cns_Dec2024_EN.pdf` | 2024 | **Cited** — Table 2 CNS |
| `ENCR-Recommendation-haematological-malignancies_Feb2014_EN.pdf` | 2014 | **Cited** — Table 2 haematological |
| `ENCR-Position-paper-haematological-coding_2015.pdf` | 2015 | **Cited** — haematological position paper |
| `ENCR-Recommendation-condensed-tnm_2002_EN.pdf` | 2002 | **Cited** — Table 2 extent of disease / condensed TNM |
| `ENCR-Data-quality-checks-ECIS_v1.1_2026_EN.pdf` | 2026 | Same page — ECIS validation checks |
| `ENCR-Position-paper-survival-in-ECIS_2025_EN.pdf` | 2025 | Same page — survival in ECIS |
| `ENCR-Recommendation-migrants_Jun2022_EN.pdf` | 2022 | Same page — migrant population |
| `ENCR-Recommendation-urothelial-tumours_Jun2022_EN.pdf` | 2022 | Same page — urothelial tumours |
| `ENCR-Guidelines-confidentiality-ethics_2012_EN.pdf` | 2012 | Same page — data protection guidelines |
| `ENCR-Position-paper-EU-data-protection_2012_EN.pdf` | 2012 | Same page — EU data-protection position paper |
| `ENCR-Recommendation-bladder-tumours_1995_EN.pdf` | 1995 | Same page — bladder tumours |
| `ENCR-Recommendation-brain-cns_1998_EN.pdf` | 1998 | Same page — brain / CNS (superseded in part by 2024 CNS) |
| `ENCR-Recommendation-non-melanoma-skin_2000_EN.pdf` | 2000 | Same page — non-melanoma skin |
| `ENCR-Recommendation-method-of-detection_2001_EN.pdf` | 2001 | Same page — method of detection |
| `ENCR-Recommendation-confidentiality_2002_EN.pdf` | 2002 | Same page — confidentiality in cancer registration |
| `ENCR-Structured-registry-review_EN.pdf` | — | Same page — structured registry review |

Not on the ENCR PDF list (endorsement news page only): [Toronto Childhood Cancer Stage Guidelines](https://encr.eu/news/encr-endorsement-toronto-childhood-cancer-stage-guidelines). Translations (ES/FR/RO/DE) were not downloaded.

v1 ingest registers these as PDF sources (checksum + original bytes). Structured table projection is Excel/CSV only until a PDF plugin exists.
